title_en: New Slang, New Stories (4/20): The "YYDS" Sign at the Beef Noodle Shop
note_en: 比起……，更…… compares two choices and says which one you prefer: 比起到处追网红店，她更愿意…… "rather than chasing trendy restaurants everywhere, she'd prefer to...." Notice the order is the reverse of 比: with 比起 the thing you're turning down comes first, and 更 marks the preferred option.
